Name: Tractor Lite - Unlimited Range Farming Without Vehicle
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Tractor Lite
[/b][/size][/center][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements
[/url]﻿[/size][/center]

[b]Tractor Lite[/b] turns your mouse cursor into an all-powerful farming tool. There is no vehicle to buy or ride—simply hold a modifier key, hover over your farm, and watch the work finish itself instantly.

This mod offers [b]Unlimited Range[/b] and [b]Auto-Chaining[/b] capabilities, allowing you to clear debris, till soil, plant seeds, and water crops across the entire screen without moving your character.


[center][size=4][color=#00ff00][b]Simulate Energy (Optional)[/b]: [/color][color=#ffff00]Enable this in the config to play fairly. It calculates vanilla energy costs based on your Farming Level and tool Enchantments (e.g., Efficient). It also drains water from your can.[/color]
[/size][/center][line]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40942/40942-1767749098-829239548.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]Mouse-Over Action[/b]
No clicking required. Just hold the activation key (Default: [b]Left Shift[/b]) and wave your mouse.[*] [b]Unlimited Range[/b]
Works on any visible tile on the screen. You do not need to stand near the target.[*] [b]Smart Tool Chaining[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Holding Seeds:[/b] The mod checks your inventory for a Hoe and Watering Can. It will [b]Till -> Plant -> Water[/b] in a single pass.
[*] [b]Holding Hoe:[/b] It will [b]Till -> Water[/b] (if a can is found).
[*] [b]Holding Fertilizer:[/b] Instantly applies fertilizer to tilled soil.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] [b]Tool Support[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Axe:[/b] Instantly chops stumps, logs, trees, bushes, and weeds.
[*] [b]Pickaxe:[/b] Breaks rocks, ores, boulders, meteorites, and flooring.
[*] [b]Scythe:[/b] Harvests grass, weeds, and scythe-harvestable crops (e.g., Kale, Amaranth).
[/list][/list][list]
[*] [b]Configuration & Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Instant / Cheat Mode (Default):[/b] By default, actions cost [b]0 Energy[/b] and consume [b]0 Water[/b] from your can.
[*] [color=#ffff00][b]Simulate Energy (Optional):[/b] Enable this in the config to play fairly. It calculates vanilla energy costs based on your Farming Level and tool Enchantments (e.g., Efficient). It also drains water from your can.[/color]
[/list][/list]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40942/40942-1767748924-746288110.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]



[line]
[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] [b]Equip a Tool or Item:[/b] Select a Seed packet, Fertilizer, Axe, Pickaxe, Scythe, or Hoe in your toolbar.
[*] [b]Hold the Activation Key:[/b] Default is [b]Left Shift[/b].
[*] [b]Hover:[/b] Move your mouse over the tiles you want to interact with.
[*] [b]Profit:[/b] The mod performs the action instantly.
[/list]

[i]Note: You must have the required tools (Hoe/Watering Can) somewhere in your inventory for the Farming logic to work.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40942/40942-1767749950-1840565257.png[/img][/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

This mod supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] for easy in-game configuration.

[b]Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Mod Enabled:[/b] Toggle the mod on/off.
[*] [b]Activation Key:[/b] Change the key used to trigger the tractor mode (Default: Left Shift).
[*] [b]Simulate Energy:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]False (Default):[/i] Infinite Stamina, Infinite Water.
[*] [i]True:[/i] Actions consume Stamina and Water normally. Scythe usage remains free.
[/list][/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the [b]TractorLite[/b] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*] Compatible with single-player and multiplayer (each player needs the mod installed).
[/list]
